claims.claim: across 27 species in another southern creek larger fish tended to move upstream and smaller ones downstream (Hall 1972, abstract)
claims.note: No full text. The abstract agrees: New Hope Creek, North Carolina, April 1968–June 1970, weirs with traps; 'Most of the 27 species had a consistent pattern of larger fish moving upstream and smaller fish moving downstream', both movements greatest in spring. The '(abstract)' tag is accurate. Which species (any sunfish) and their sizes need the full text.

claims.claim: the larger [fish] move upstream — Hall 1972 (supporting the review's estimate that abundance rises with depth in the brook's pools)
claims.note: Consistent with the abstract (larger fish upstream). The abstract does not speak to depth or pools, so Hall 1972 supports only the 'larger move upstream' part of that comment.
